item.title: He Survived Nine Gunshots To Uncover A Shocking Plot
item.description: Baron Li survived being shot nine times outside his Bellevue home in 2020. What initially appeared to be a random attack was later traced to his ex-wife, who recruited two teenagers in a plot linked to their bitter custody dispute.

item.title: The Affair That Led Investigators To Rusty’s Killer
item.description: Russell “Rusty” Sneiderman was killed outside his son’s daycare in 2010. Investigators eventually identified his wife’s boss, Hemy Neuman, who admitted the shooting and was later convicted of murder. Andrea Sneiderman was separately convicted of lying to police and under oath.

item.title: Her Husband Was Charged But Her Body Was Never Found
item.description: Jennifer Dulos disappeared in May 2019 during a bitter divorce and custody battle. Her estranged husband Fotis Dulos was charged with her murder but died before trial, while his girlfriend Michelle Troconis was later convicted of conspiring to murder Jennifer and helping cover up the crime.

item.title: She Vanished Months Before Anyone Reported Her Missing
item.description: Five-year-old Oakley Carlson was last credibly seen in February 2021 but was not reported missing until December. Her parents gave conflicting accounts of her whereabouts, and investigators continue to treat her disappearance as a suspected homicide. Oakley was declared legally dead in 2025, but her remains have never been found.

item.title: Did Jealousy Lure Heather Elvis To Her Disappearance?
item.description: Heather Elvis vanished in December 2013 after prosecutors said she was lured to a South Carolina boat landing by Sidney and Tammy Moorer. Both were convicted of kidnapping and conspiracy, but Heather has never been found and murder charges were ultimately dropped.

item.title: She Was Living In The Same City All Along
item.description: Melissa Highsmith was abducted from Fort Worth as a 21-month-old in 1971. More than five decades later, a 23andMe DNA match led her biological family to her, and official testing confirmed her identity in 2023. She had been living under another name in the same city.

item.title: He Walked Away In 2019 And Was Found Six Years Later
item.description: Chance Englebert disappeared after walking away from his wife’s grandparents’ home in Nebraska in July 2019. After years of searches and unanswered questions, his remains were discovered at Scotts Bluff National Monument in 2025, and authorities ruled his death accidental.

item.title: A Pastor Returned Home To A Crime Scene
item.description: Amanda Blackburn was killed during a 2015 home invasion in Indianapolis while her husband was away at the gym. Investigators arrested three men in connection with the case; Larry Jo Taylor Jr. was later convicted of her murder, while two others pleaded guilty to related charges.

item.title: An Affair Ended With A Deadly Parking Lot Confrontation
item.description: In 2011, Idaho attorney Emmett Corrigan was shot and killed after an affair with Kandi Hall, whose husband Robert had confronted the pair. Hall claimed self-defense, but a jury convicted him of second-degree murder and he was sentenced to 30 years in prison.
